definitions: To advance or raise to a higher position or rank.
To support or actively encourage (a cause, venture, etc.); further the progress of.
To publicize a product, organization, or venture so as to increase sales or public awareness.
To move (a sports team) to a higher division.
examples: She was promoted to senior manager.
The campaign aims to promote healthy eating.
They are promoting their new album.
The team was promoted to the Premier League.
